brief: 5 signs you're a people pleaser and how to stop today.

slots.title: PEOPLE PLEASER SIGNS AND HOW TO STOP
SORRY IS YOUR DEFAULT WORD
slots.body: You say sorry for things that are not your fault. This erodes your confidence and teaches others to overlook your boundaries. Catch yourself and pause before apologizing.

slots.title: YOU CANNOT SAY NO
slots.body: You agree to plans you hate and take on work you cannot handle. Every yes to them is a no to yourself. Practice declining small requests first.

slots.title: YOU CRAVE OUTSIDE APPROVAL
slots.body: Your mood depends on whether others praise your work. You overcommit just to hear that you are enough. Start validating your own effort internally first.

slots.title: YOU AVOID ALL CONFLICT
slots.body: You stay silent when boundaries are crossed to keep the peace. This builds resentment and sends the message that your needs do not matter. Speak up calmly and early.

slots.title: YOU FEEL GUILTY RESTING
slots.body: You force productivity because downtime feels selfish or lazy. Real self-care is not earned; it is required for sustainable performance. Schedule rest like a non-negotiable meeting.

slots.title: DRAW THE LINE TODAY
slots.body: Stopping starts with one honest no and a clear boundary. Your needs are not negotiable. Choose yourself first, even if your voice shakes.

slots.headline: STOP PLEASING START LIVING
slots.body: Choose boundaries over approval starting right now.
